mapper.select: select id, video_id, task_id, audio_id, provider, provider_task_id, language, full_text, utterances_json, duration_ms, created_at, updated_at from ai_media_transcript where task_id = #{taskId}

select id, video_id, task_id, audio_id, provider, provider_task_id, language, full_text, duration_ms, created_at, updated_at from ai_media_transcript where id = ( select max(id) from ai_media_transcript where video_id = #{videoId} )

with recursive page_index as ( select 0 as value union all select value + 1 from page_index where value + 1 < #{limit} ) select #{offset} + page_index.value + 1 as segmentNo, cast(json_unquote(json_extract( transcript.utterances_json, concat('$[', #{offset} + page_index.value, '].start_time') )) as unsigned) as startTime, cast(json_unquote(json_extract( transcript.utterances_json, concat('$[', #{offset} + page_index.value, '].end_time') )) as unsigned) as endTime, json_unquote(json_extract( transcript.utterances_json, concat('$[', #{offset} + page_index.value, '].text') )) as text, coalesce( nullif(json_unquote(json_extract( transcript.utterances_json, concat('$[', #{offset} + page_index.value, '].speaker') )), 'null'), nullif(json_unquote(json_extract( transcript.utterances_json, concat('$[', #{offset} + page_index.value, '].additions.speaker') )), 'null') ) as speaker from ai_media_transcript transcript cross join page_index where transcript.id = ( select max(id) from ai_media_transcript where video_id = #{videoId} ) and #{offset} + page_index.value < json_length(transcript.utterances_json) order by page_index.value
